messages:
Maya (PM): TL;DR we shipped v1.3 overnight. getting 3 reports of degraded embeddings on very long contexts and a few asks for a clearer streaming UI. want to triage and set next-steps.
Ethan (Eng): initial traces point to a batching heuristic tweak increasing KV cache churn for sequences >10k tokens. repro is flaky but repeatable on long-prefix corpora.
Noor (Runtime): adding extra evict logs — packer is evicting earlier under the new pack strategy, looks like an off-by-one in the slot calc.
Samir (QA): nightly job failed on long-prefix embed test (PR #472). I can add a focused regression harness but need the failing corpora from CS.
Maya (PM): will fetch the two customer corpora and drop links here.
Priya (SRE): infra saw p95 latency increase during the deploy window (~02:00 UTC). not saturated, more a taily latency shift. Recommend a conservative canary.
Zoe (Design): streaming indicator ask is small: replace persistent spinner with progress + elapsed time. customers say it reduces friction for long responses. low effort.
Maya (PM): proposal: reliability-first for this cycle. Plan: 60% on embedding regression (hotfix toggle, synthetic repro, canary), 40% on UX micro-improvement (A/B). Agree?
Ethan (Eng): +1. Mitigation steps: 1) implement rollback toggle to previous packing heuristic, 2) instrument and run synthetic repro job, 3) patch cache behavior if root cause confirmed. Toggle first.
Noor (Runtime): I can land a runtime flag today to flip packer behavior; low-risk and reversible.
Samir (QA): once corpora are posted I can wire harness into CI in ~24h, add smoke checklist.
release-bot: deploy-plan created: canary=5% -> monitor=[p50_latency,p95_latency,embed_cos_sim] -> auto-rollback triggers set to embed_cos_sim drop >0.02 or p95 rise >15%.
Priya (SRE): I'll run the canary and own the runbook. also proposing a scheduled synthetic embed job every 6h against the long-prefix testset to catch regressions early.
Ethan (Eng): fallback idea: short-batch mode for sequences >8k tokens until we have a durable fix. cheap and reversible.
Zoe (Design): will produce A/B assets and a short spec. recommend 10% A/B for 2 weeks.
Maya (PM): owners: Ethan (bug lead), Noor (runtime), Samir (QA), Priya (canary), Zoe (UX). Targets: toggle + canary in 48h, regression harness + CI guard in 72h, UX A/B in 72h.
Samir (QA): smoke checklist: run repro harness; compare embed cosine similarity vs baseline (threshold 0.02); basic downstream ranking sanity on 10 queries.
Ethan (Eng): creating HOTFIX PR and tagging runtime pair.
Maya (PM): note for roadmap: this iteration re-weights to reliability over new feature work; small UX polish accepted when it reduces support volume. we'll re-sort backlog at next planning.
Priya (SRE): requesting an alert to page if embed_cos_sim degrades >0.015 for 30m during canary.
release-bot: monitor rule added: page on embed_cos_sim < baseline - 0.015 for 30m.
Maya (PM): thanks all. check back here after canary metrics. ping me directly for blockers :pray:
